```{r}

###stage

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Summarise counts and percentages by risk group and stage
stage_summary <- clin_risk %>%
  filter(!is.na(stage)) %>%
  count(risk_grp, stage) %>%
  group_by(risk_grp) %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = n / sum(n) * 100,
   label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Per-stage p-values using chi-square on a proper 2x2 table
#    Table: risk_grp (Low/High) x in_this_stage (TRUE/FALSE)
clin_filtered <- clin_risk %>% filter(!is.na(stage))

stages <- sort(unique(clin_filtered$stage))

stage_pvals <- lapply(stages, function(s) {
  tab <- table(
    risk_grp   = clin_filtered$risk_grp,
    in_stage   = clin_filtered$stage == s
  )
  p <- tryCatch(chisq.test(tab)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  data.frame(
    stage  = s,
    p      = p,
    signif = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p)    ~ "ns",
      p < 0.001   ~ "***",
      p < 0.01    ~ "**",
      p < 0.05    ~ "*",
      TRUE        ~ "ns"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# 3. y-positions for brackets per stage
# In step 3 — increase bracket height above bars
brackets <- stage_summary %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(stage_pvals, by = "stage") %>%
  mutate(
    y_bracket = y_max + 13,   # was 6, now 12
    y_star    = y_max + 15    # was 8, now 14
  )

# 4. Base plot
p_stage <- ggplot(stage_summary, aes(x = factor(stage), y = pct, fill = risk_grp)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3, size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
  scale_x_discrete() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(brackets$y_star, na.rm = TRUE) + 6)) +
  labs(
    title = "Stage Distribution by Risk Group",
    x = "Stage", y = "% within risk group", fill = "Risk Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

# 5. Add GraphPad-style brackets + stars per stage
for (i in seq_len(nrow(brackets))) {
  s   <- brackets$stage[i]
  yb  <- brackets$y_bracket[i]
  ys  <- brackets$y_star[i]
  lab <- brackets$signif[i]

  if (is.na(lab) || lab == "ns") next

  x_center <- which(levels(factor(stages)) == as.character(s))

  p_stage <- p_stage +
    annotate("segment",
      x = x_center - 0.2, xend = x_center + 0.2,
      y = yb, yend = yb) +
    annotate("segment",
      x = x_center - 0.2, xend = x_center - 0.2,
      y = yb, yend = yb - 3) +
    annotate("segment",
      x = x_center + 0.2, xend = x_center + 0.2,
      y = yb, yend = yb - 3) +
    annotate("text",
      x = x_center, y = ys,
      label = lab, size = 4)
}

p_stage

# See the table that ggplot is using
stage_summary

# Check total N used for percentages
stage_summary %>% summarise(
  total_n = sum(n),
  n_risk_low = sum(n[risk_grp == "Low"]),
  n_risk_high = sum(n[risk_grp == "High"])
)

# How many rows total?
nrow(clin_risk)

# How many non-NA stage rows?
sum(!is.na(clin_risk$stage))

# Simple cross-tab of risk_grp x stage (raw counts)
table(clin_risk$risk_grp, clin_risk$stage, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)

# ── 0. Colours ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
colours <- c("Low" = "#004B23", "High" = "#800000")

# ── 1. Clean binary treatment variables ───────────────────────────────────────
for (var in c("has_adjuvant_chemotherapy",
              "has_neoadjuvant_chemoradiotherapy")) {
  clin_risk[[var]][!clin_risk[[var]] %in% c("yes", "no")] <- NA
  clin_risk[[var]] <- factor(clin_risk[[var]], levels = c("no", "yes"))
}

# ── 2. Clean molecular variables ──────────────────────────────────────────────
clin_risk$cms_subtype <- factor(
  ifelse(clin_risk$cms_subtype %in% c("CMS1", "CMS2", "CMS3", "CMS4"),
         as.character(clin_risk$cms_subtype), NA),
  levels = c("CMS1", "CMS2", "CMS3", "CMS4")
)

clin_risk$kras_status <- factor(
  ifelse(clin_risk$kras_status %in% c("mutant", "wild_type"),
         as.character(clin_risk$kras_status), NA),
  levels = c("mutant", "wild_type")
)

# ── 3. Build plot_df ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_vars <- c("risk_grp", "age", "stage",
               "has_adjuvant_chemotherapy",
               "has_neoadjuvant_chemoradiotherapy",
               "kras_status", "p53_status", "cms_subtype")

plot_df <- clin_risk %>%
  select(all_of(plot_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ mean(is.na(.)) <= 0.9))

cat("Columns retained:\n"); print(names(plot_df))
cat("Rows:", nrow(plot_df), "\n")

# ── 4. Standard cat_plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat_plot <- function(var, title) {
  if (!var %in% names(plot_df)) {
    message(var, " was removed (>90% NA) — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(risk_grp)) %>%
    count(risk_grp, .data[[var]]) %>%
    group_by(risk_grp) %>%
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()

  colnames(df)[2] <- "category"

  tab <- table(
    plot_df$risk_grp[!is.na(plot_df[[var]]) & !is.na(plot_df$risk_grp)],
    plot_df[[var]][!is.na(plot_df[[var]]) & !is.na(plot_df$risk_grp)]
  )

  pval <- tryCatch(
    chisq.test(tab)$p.value,
    warning = function(w) chisq.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE)$p.value,
    error   = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  p_lab <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(pval)  ~ "p = NA",
    pval < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
    pval < 0.01  ~ paste0("p = ", round(pval, 3)),
    TRUE         ~ paste0("p = ", round(pval, 2))
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = category, y = pct, fill = risk_grp)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
    annotate("text",
             x = Inf, y = Inf, label = p_lab,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
             size = 3.2, colour = "grey30") +
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = "% within risk group", fill = "Risk Group") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
}

# ── 5. CMS plot with per-subtype chi-sq brackets ──────────────────────────────
cms_plot <- function() {
  df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(cms_subtype), !is.na(risk_grp)) %>%
    count(risk_grp, cms_subtype) %>%
    group_by(risk_grp) %>%
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::complete(risk_grp, cms_subtype, fill = list(n = 0, pct = 0))

  stat_df <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(plot_df$cms_subtype), function(s) {
    sub <- plot_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(risk_grp), cms_subtype == s)

    tab <- table(sub$risk_grp)

    pval <- tryCatch(
      chisq.test(tab)$p.value,
      warning = function(w) chisq.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE)$p.value,
      error   = function(e) NA_real_
    )

    pval_adj <- min(pval * 4, 1)

    data.frame(
      cms      = s,
      p_raw    = pval,
      p_adj    = pval_adj,
      p.signif = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(pval_adj)  ~ "ns",
        pval_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        pval_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE             ~ "ns"
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) %>% filter(p.signif != "ns")

  y_max <- max(df$pct, na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cms_subtype, y = pct, fill = risk_grp)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max * 1.35)) +
    labs(title = "CMS Subtype", x = "", y = "% within risk group",
         fill = "Risk Group") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))

  if (nrow(stat_df) > 0) {
    dodge_w  <- 0.9
    bar_half <- dodge_w / 4

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(stat_df))) {
      s       <- stat_df$cms[i]
      x_pos   <- which(levels(plot_df$cms_subtype) == s)
      x_left  <- x_pos - bar_half
      x_right <- x_pos + bar_half

      bar_heights <- df %>% filter(cms_subtype == s) %>% pull(pct)
      y_top  <- max(bar_heights, na.rm = TRUE)
      y_br   <- y_top + y_max * 0.08
      y_star <- y_br  + y_max * 0.07

      p <- p +
        annotate("segment",
                 x = x_left, xend = x_right,
                 y = y_br,   yend = y_br) +
        annotate("segment",
                 x = x_left, xend = x_left,
                 y = y_br,   yend = y_br - y_max * 0.04) +
        annotate("segment",
                 x = x_right, xend = x_right,
                 y = y_br,    yend = y_br - y_max * 0.04) +
        annotate("text",
                 x = (x_left + x_right) / 2, y = y_star,
                 label = stat_df$p.signif[i], size = 5)
    }
  }

  p
}

cms_plot()

'''  # ── Overall chi-sq p in top right ─────────────────────────────────────────
  overall_p <- tryCatch({
    tab <- table(plot_df$risk_grp[!is.na(plot_df$cms_subtype)],

    chisq.test(tab)$p.value

cms_plot()
# ── 6. Print plots ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat_plot("has_adjuvant_chemotherapy",         "Adjuvant Chemo")
cat_plot("has_neoadjuvant_chemoradiotherapy", "Neoadjuvant CRT")
cat_plot("kras_status", "KRAS Status")
cat_plot("p53_status",  "P53 Status")
cms_plot()
```

```{r}
#####regression side project out of curiosity
library(survival)

# ── 1. Define your chosen MC covariates explicitly ────────────────────────────
mc_vars <- c(
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_0",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_47",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_30",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_7",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_5",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_10",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_13",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_17",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_8",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_6",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_14",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_38",
  "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_85"
)

# ── 2. Build modelling data frame ─────────────────────────────────────────────
cox_df <- merged_df[, c(
  "dfs_months", "dfs_event",
  "T_stage", "positive_nodes", "cms_subtype",
  mc_vars
)]

# ── 3. Make sure types are right ──────────────────────────────────────────────
cox_df$T_stage <- factor(cox_df$T_stage)

# cms_subtype: make sure it is treated as categorical
cox_df$cms_subtype <- factor(as.character(cox_df$cms_subtype))

# (Optional) set a reference level, e.g. most common CMS
cms_counts <- sort(table(cox_df$cms_subtype), decreasing = TRUE)
ref_level  <- names(cms_counts)[1]
cox_df$cms_subtype <- relevel(cox_df$cms_subtype, ref = ref_level)

# ── 4. Drop rows with any NA in model vars ────────────────────────────────────
cox_df <- cox_df[complete.cases(cox_df), ]

# ── 5. Fit Cox model ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cox_fit <- coxph(
  as.formula(
    paste(
      "Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~",
      "T_stage + positive_nodes + cms_subtype +",
      paste(mc_vars, collapse = " + ")
    )
  ),
  data = cox_df
)

summary(cox_fit)

# ── 6. Diagnostics to confirm structure ───────────────────────────────────────
# 1. What does cox_df look like?
dim(cox_df)
str(cox_df)

# 2. How many complete cases across all model vars?
sum(complete.cases(cox_df[, c(
  "dfs_months", "dfs_event",
  "T_stage", "positive_nodes", "cms_subtype",
  mc_vars
)]))

# 3. Any NAs in the survival outcome itself?
colSums(is.na(cox_df[, c("dfs_months", "dfs_event")]))

# 4. Check that T_stage etc actually exist and are non-empty
table(cox_df$T_stage, useNA = "ifany")
table(cox_df$cms_subtype, useNA = "ifany")
summary(cox_df$positive_nodes)

summ <- summary(cox_fit)

# data frame of coefficients
coef_df <- data.frame(
  term  = rownames(summ$coefficients),
  summ$coefficients,
  check.names = FALSE
)

coef_df

sig_terms <- subset(
  coef_df,
  `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05 & !is.na(`Pr(>|z|)`) & `se(coef)` > 0
)$term

sig_terms
```
